title: moekura
description: Requests, background jobs and database pools of a moekura image board, from the metrics its `serve` and `worker` processes expose on `telemetry.metrics_bind`.

panels.title: Instances up
panels.description: Share of scraped moekura processes that answered the last scrape.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests answered per second.

panels.title: Server errors
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(moekura_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(moekura_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile of request duration.

panels.title: Jobs due
panels.description: Background jobs due now and waiting for a worker.

panels.title: Oldest due job
panels.description: How long the longest-waiting due job has waited. Growing means the workers are behind.

panels.title: Dead jobs
panels.description: Jobs that failed for good and will not be retried. See `moekura jobs` to inspect and retry them.

panels.title: DB pool in use
panels.description: Busiest database pool's connections in use, as a share of its limit.

targets.expr: max(moekura_db_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", state="in_use"} / ignoring(state) moekura_db_connections_max{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Requests answered per second, by status class.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Request duration percentiles across all selected routes, estimated from the histogram.

panels.title: Requests by route
panels.description: The ten busiest routes. `unmatched` is requests that matched no route.

panels.title: p95 latency by route
panels.description: The ten slowest routes by 95th percentile duration.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, le) (rate(moekura_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Server errors by route
panels.description: 5xx responses per second, by route and status.

targets.expr: sum by (route, status) (rate(moekura_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Client errors by route
panels.description: The ten largest sources of 4xx responses. 404s on `unmatched` are usually crawlers and scanners.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (route, status) (rate(moekura_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: Every route over the dashboard's time range.

targets.expr: (sum by (route) (increase(moekura_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or sum by (route) (increase(moekura_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (route) (increase(moekura_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (route, le) (rate(moekura_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range]))) >= 0
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, le) (rate(moekura_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range]))) >= 0
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (route, le) (rate(moekura_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", route=~"$route"}[$__range]))) >= 0

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Requests being answered right now, per process.

panels.title: Request duration distribution
panels.description: How request durations are distributed over time (histogram buckets).

panels.title: Jobs by state
panels.description: Jobs `ready` (due now), `scheduled` (for later), `running` and `dead` (failed for good).

panels.title: Due jobs by kind
panels.description: Jobs due now and not yet picked up, by kind.

panels.title: Oldest due job by kind
panels.description: How long each kind's longest-waiting due job has waited.

panels.title: Jobs finished
panels.description: Jobs run per second: `done`, `retry` (failed; retried while attempts remain), `failed` (could never succeed) or `panicked`.

panels.title: Failing jobs by kind
panels.description: Job runs that did not succeed, by kind and result.

targets.expr: sum by (kind, result) (rate(moekura_jobs_finished_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", kind=~"$kind", result!="done"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Job duration p95 by kind
panels.description: 95th percentile run time of each job kind. Kinds that rarely run show as points.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (kind, le) (rate(moekura_job_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", kind=~"$kind"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Dead jobs by kind
panels.description: Jobs that failed for good, by kind. Inspect them with `moekura jobs`.

panels.title: Job kinds
panels.description: Job runs per kind over the dashboard's time range.

targets.expr: (sum by (kind) (increase(moekura_jobs_finished_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", kind=~"$kind", result!="done"}[$__range])) or sum by (kind) (increase(moekura_jobs_finished_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", kind=~"$kind"}[$__range])) * 0) / (sum by (kind) (increase(moekura_jobs_finished_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", kind=~"$kind"}[$__range])) > 0)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (kind, le) (rate(moekura_job_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", kind=~"$kind"}[$__range]))) >= 0

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Open connections in each pool, `in_use` and `idle`, against the pool's limit (summed over the selected processes).

panels.title: Pool utilisation
panels.description: Connections in use as a share of each pool's limit. Requests wait for a connection when a pool is full.

targets.expr: sum by (pool) (moekura_db_connections{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", state="in_use"}) / sum by (pool) (moekura_db_connections_max{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

list.description: Route templates, for the HTTP panels

list.description: Background job kinds, for the job panels
